European Leaders Warn of Russian Provocation Against NATO

European leaders have stated that Russia is provoking NATO, raising concerns about how the alliance will respond. The Polish Prime Minister specifically warned that Russia is planning attacks on NATO territory. The coverage does not provide further details on the nature of these provocations or specific planned attacks, nor does it detail the potential responses from NATO.
